evals.prompt: I want to create a skills reference guide for my project. I have some custom skills in .claude/skills but I'm not sure what we've built. Can you organize them for me? I'd like to understand the landscape — all frameworks, one document.
evals.expected_output: A single comprehensive markdown document with all three frameworks (Workflow-Based, Domain-Based, Capability Layer), TOC, and organized skill listings. Should be saved to project root.

evals.prompt: I need to document our skills by workflow so the team knows what skills help with what task. Just the Workflow-Based framework. I'd prefer separate files if we ever add more frameworks later.
evals.expected_output: A markdown document organized by Workflow-Based framework only (Git & Version Control, Research & Synthesis, Writing, Design, Code Quality sections). Saved with a clear filename indicating the framework.

evals.prompt: Generate a quick skills catalog. Put all three frameworks in one file, save it to docs/ folder so I can commit it.
evals.expected_output: A single markdown file with all three frameworks, saved to docs/ directory. Should include TOC and all skill categories with descriptions.
